title: Emitter counter update in phase zero
statement: For any gate kind, natural numbers $z,a,j$, and Boolean list $r$, processing $j$ consecutive true bits from phase $u(k,0)$ leaves the output unchanged and increases the first argument counter from $a$ to $a+j$: the resulting run is the run from phase $u(k,0)$ with counters $(z,a+j,0)$ on input $r$.
